subtitle: Countable/uncountable + some/any + How much/How many · week & home.
heroImageAlt: Calendar week planner with home and beach icons

ivi.welcome: Hi! I'm iVi for Lesson 17. Ask about much/many and some/any.

q1.hint: How many vs How much; any in questions.

q2.hint: some in affirmative; any in negative/question.

exercises.hint: How many + countable; How much + uncountable; some/any.
exercises.explanation: How many days…? How much coffee…? any milk…? don't have any sugar…

items.label: a
items.original: Quantos dias você trabalha na semana?
answers: How many days do you work in a week?
How many days a week do you work?

items.label: b
items.original: Quanto café você bebe por dia?
answers: How much coffee do you drink a day?
How much coffee do you drink per day?

items.label: c
items.original: Você tem algum leite na geladeira?
answers: Do you have any milk in the fridge?
Do you have any milk in the refrigerator?

items.label: d
items.original: Eu não tenho nenhum açúcar em casa.
answers: I don't have any sugar at home
I don't have any sugar at home.
I do not have any sugar at home
I do not have any sugar at home.

items.label: e
answers: How many spoons do you need?
How many tablespoons do you need?

exercises.hint: How much time…? some / any / no.
exercises.explanation: How much time…? some fruit… any homework… How many hours…? don't have any appointments…

items.label: f
items.original: Quanto tempo você tem na segunda-feira?
answers: How much time do you have on Monday?

items.label: g
items.original: Eles querem algumas frutas no domingo.
answers: They want some fruits on Sunday
They want some fruits on Sunday.
They want some fruit on Sunday
They want some fruit on Sunday.

items.label: h
items.original: Você tem alguma tarefa na sexta-feira?
answers: Do you have any homework on Friday?
Do you have any tasks on Friday?
Do you have any assignments on Friday?

items.label: i
items.original: Quantas horas você estuda no sábado?
answers: How many hours do you study on Saturday?

items.label: j
items.original: Eu não tenho nenhum compromisso na quarta-feira.
answers: I don't have any appointments on Wednesday
I don't have any appointments on Wednesday.
